children: Curve DAO went live on Arc on September 17th. Stablecoin issuers can launch pools, including foreign-exchange markets, with simulations and parameter tuning before deployment.
Bringing a stablecoin to Arc? We can help you launch a pool, including FX markets, with simulations and parameter tuning ahead of deployment

Curve Finance is a decentralized automated market maker protocol tailored for the exchange of stablecoins. It provides a platform with minimal fees and slippage, enhancing the efficiency of stablecoin trading.

The protocol operates as a liquidity aggregator. Users can contribute their assets to various liquidity pools to optimize returns from fees. Additionally, Curve stands out for its capability to facilitate swaps between different tokenized representations of a specific asset, exemplified by its proficiency in exchanging various tokenized forms of Bitcoin, like WBTC, renBTC, and sBTC.

CRV is the foundational governance token for CurveDAO, the decentralized entity overseeing the Curve protocol. This token is periodically allocated to the protocol’s liquidity providers as a reward, with the distribution rate set to decrease each year.

title: Curve DAO to Be Integrated With Arc
